mapper.select: SELECT S.SETTLE_ID, S.MEMBER_ID, M.MEMBER_NM, S.AMOUNT, S.STATUS, S.REG_DT FROM TB_SETTLE S JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON S.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY S.REG_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SETTLE (SETTLE_ID, MEMBER_ID, AMOUNT, STATUS, REG_DT) VALUES (SEQ_SETTLE.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{amount}, #{status}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SETTLE SET STATUS = #{status}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE SETTLE_ID = #{settleId}
UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET SETTLE_BALANCE = SETTLE_BALANCE + #{amount} WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
